headline: Near-term regulatory hurdles may dampen growth run-rate

highlights: However, incremental wage costs of ~INR 60mn and North Bangalore losses of INR 61mn weighed on margins.
HCG added 146 beds in H1FY27; it plans to add another 42 beds in H2FY27, which could boost growth.
Besides, the North Bangalore hospital is expected to achieve monthly EBITDA break-even in Q4FY27, which will likely aid profitability.
Management is articulating a plan to absorb the impact (7–9% hit to EBITDA ahead) from drug margin curb, It guides for 14–16% revenue growth and 17–19% EBITDA growth for FY28.
valuation: Maintain BUY, revise TP to INR 700, based on 17x FY28E EV/EBITDA.
Revenue is ramping up, in-line with management’s expectations with monthly EBITDA break-even targeted in Q4FY27.
The stock currently trades at a multiple of 17.8x FY27E and 14.6x FY28E EV/EBITDA.
watch: The recent trade-margin cap on oncology drugs presents a near-term headwind.
Key downside risks: Higher competition in oncology, and delay in operational turnaround of new centres.
